description: Email the Puzzled support team about your account, games or data. A person replies, normally within 24-48 hours.

contact.subtitle: The support inbox takes playing and account questions. Privacy and legal enquiries have their own addresses.

accessibility.answer: Support varies by puzzle, and an honest picture matters more than a slogan. In place today: a skip-to-content link on the main site; labels on the icon-only controls in the games; live regions that announce status and results in several puzzles; visible keyboard focus outlines; and custom animation switched off when your system asks for reduced motion. Known gap: some in-game control labels are still English only, whatever interface language you pick. If a puzzle blocks you, email support with the puzzle name and what happened, so the team can look at that case.
